purpose: Test one canonical low-frequency cross-asset ETF relative-momentum hypothesis after the intraday ETF lane failed, without reusing or retuning intraday rules.
universe_rule: Fixed before any PnL; no substitutions after results.

data.missing_rule: A monthly observation is ineligible if any required common-session decision, lookback, entry or exit bar is missing for any universe member. No fallback date or ticker substitution.

signal.decision: Last common US trading session of each calendar month after the close.
signal.score: (close_at_t_minus_21 - close_at_t_minus_252 + sum(split_adjusted_cash_dividends with ex_date > t_minus_252 and <= t_minus_21)) / close_at_t_minus_252
signal.ranking: Descending score; ties broken alphabetically by ticker.
signal.portfolio: Long top 3, equal target weight 1/3 each.
signal.reversed_control: Long bottom 3, equal target weight 1/3 each, same dates and economics.
signal.benchmark: Long all 10, equal target weight 0.1 each.

execution.entry: Next common US trading session open after decision date.
execution.holding_return: (exit_open - entry_open + sum(split_adjusted_cash_dividends with ex_date > entry_date and <= exit_date)) / entry_open
execution.turnover_proxy: 0.5 * sum(abs(target_weight_t - target_weight_previous)) across all 10 ETFs. Initial prior weights are zero.
execution.note: Membership/target-weight turnover proxy ignores small drift-restoration trades when target membership is unchanged; this is a stated limitation, not adjusted after results.
